failure_mode=metadata_only. The zbMATH source was treated as a resolver rather than a technical source. Local shell fetching failed because network DNS resolution is unavailable in the sandbox. Bounded recovery used exact-work searches for the zbMATH identifier, exact title, page range, and MR 728620. Inspected candidates included https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BA00555905, https://eudml.org/doc/290594, https://www.numdam.org/articles/10.1016/j.crma.2013.12.015/, and https://www.bdim.eu/item?id=BUMI_2009_9_2_3_537_0; these were bibliographic references, book catalog records, or citing-paper reference lists, and none exposed a readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work artifact was recovered. Extracting from abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or citing-paper references would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-3836192.json and outputs/latest.json.
